text_block_list.text:
With the Hanshin JF just around the 
corner, a certain piece of news was 
causing a stir in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—This year's Oka Sho champion, who 
finished last in the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup due to injury, has officially 
announced an extended hiatus."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"After all, even that famous Derby 
Umamusume suffered an injury in the Kikuka 
Sho this year and entered a long 
hiatus..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"With so many G1 Umamusume suffering 
injuries lately, as a fan, I'm truly 
heartbroken."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"—I especially loved how she charged from 
behind in the Oka Sho. I've been cheering 
for her all along, but... um... right now, 
I just want her to get some good rest."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I thought she was just getting 
started. The way she won the Derby was so 
cool... I really hope... she comes 
back..."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
" 'Among racing fans in town as well, many 
have voiced their sorrow regarding this 
string of injuries—' "

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...My heart aches.

This year's Derby and Oka Sho victors. Two 
who were supposed to shine even brighter 
as representatives of their generation. 
Their departure from the front lines was 
far too sudden—

I've seen Umamusume running on the front 
lines get injured countess times before, 
but... there's always pain there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"So it really is that harsh, isn't it... 
...Competing in a GⅠ race, that is."

"Every Umamusume stepping up to a GⅠ race 
hones and pushes herself to the absolute 
limit, racing toward victory with 
life-or-death resolve."

She gives her heart and soul for that 
single victory, at times showing a run 
that surpasses her limits, but—

The price paid for exceeding one's limits 
in a grueling race is often a heavy one...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Even so, I—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I intend to face the harshness head-on 
with proper maintenance and management, 
and fight through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Though there is sorrow piercing my 
heart... I feel no fear."

I must follow Ikuno Dictus's example—her 
unwavering determination to fight through 
to the end, and the way she carries 
herself...!
choice_data_list:
I'll analyze that series of injuries as 
well.

text_block_list.text:
To ensure Ikuno Dictus never faces a 
similar tragedy in her upcoming battles, I 
intend to take every preventative measure 
possible right now.
choice_data_list: We've got to do everything we can.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us manage everything 
thoroughly.
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *haah*... *haah*...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(It's started getting pretty chilly in the 
evenings. I need to take extra care of my 
health—)
Aah! It's Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ines-san and Ryan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Are you out for roadwork too? We were just 
taking a break.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, our classmates gathered together 
again!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's true—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Man, but both Ines and Ikuno-chan are 
planning to challenge a GⅠ next month... 
that's so amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. ...If I recall correctly, 
Ines-san, you are scheduled to run in the 
Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Man, I can't wait! I wanna 
tear it up in a GⅠ race already~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that! Riding on that 
momentum, I'm gonna run the Classic races, 
too! I'll even win the 'Japanese Derby'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines is so amazing. I... need to learn 
from her too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is a bit of a change of subject, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"What did you two think... about the 
previous Derby Umamusume's injury?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...It's disappointing, and so sad. 
Terribly so. And above all... she must be 
feeling so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"She definitely wanted to keep running 
more. And yet, for it to end like that—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I think I'm just a little bit different.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, just like Ryan said, I'm 
sad and disappointed about it too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I totally understand how lonely the fans 
must feel... Getting injured really is 
painful, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...And yet—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Before that... before worrying about 
injuries... I just can't help but admire 
it."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Putting everything I have... my heart and 
soul... giving it all, giving it all, 
giving it all—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She finally seized victory... with that 
incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I have one too, y'know. Something I'd 
risk everything to seize.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"If it's to grasp that dream, I don't care 
if I have to give every last bit of 
myself." Because she truly means it—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—I truly respect her. That Umamusume who 
seized glory.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …………I want to run like that too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past the limit, staking everything 
on a single moment, laying everything 
bare—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run an amazing race just like 
that!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ines-san—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Urrrgh. Talking about it is making me 
all antsy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, you two! I'm gonna run ahead for a 
bit!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ines!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhhh!!! I wanna run in a race 
alreaaaady!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...! Such sharp and powerful—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Ikuno-chan! I have to go catch up 
to Ines, so I'm heading out too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, take care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —Ines-! I'm coming too--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Put everything on the line," huh—

Ikuno Dictus's first GⅠ, the Hanshin JF, 
was right around the corner—
